description: Bounded idle-scene slice (ticket #5): 1P Ryu vs CPU Retsu round-1 intro, frames 2280-2388 of the same boot path as sf-fixed-fight-01 (coin, start, default country). No fight inputs: Ryu's walk-in and Retsu's jump-in are the game's own intro script; the interval ends one frame before the CPU's first AI action (2390) and before the TIME HUD appears (2390). FIGHT! text is written at 2360 (visible at scanout 2361); sound latch commands at 2280 (0x28) and 2361 (0x94). Checkpoints every frame 2280-2388.

reference.notes: US set 1, six-button controls; MAME set sf. ROM set verified by mame -verifyroms against the pinned build.

machine.dipswitches: factory defaults; observed readback DSW1=0xdfff, DSW2=0xffff
